summary: G. Willi-Food International Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing an updated investor presentation for Q2 2026. The filing is a routine capital markets disclosure with no transactional element, no M&A activity, no shareholder actions, and no strategic process. It includes forward-looking statements about risks such as construction delays at a new logistics center. No deal terms, prices, premiums, or recommendations are presented. The registrant is merely the issuer providing updated business information to investors, consistent with standard foreign private issuer reporting obligations under SEC Rule 13a-16.
